caseName: Parmelee v. Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Mary A. Parmelee, as Administratrix of the Estate of David Parmelee, in Error v. Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Railway Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Arthur E. -Griffin and Mr. Thomas B. McMariin for plaintiff in error., Mr. Neman H. Field for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with *659costs upon, the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co. v. King, 222 U. S. 222; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668, 673; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Koennecke, 239 U. S. 352, 355; Great Northern Ry. Co. v. Knapp, 240 U. S. 464, 466; Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co. v. Whitacre, 242 U. S. 169.

Mr. Arthur E. -Griffin and Mr. Thomas B. McMariin for plaintiff in error. Mr. Neman H. Field for defendant in error.
